const std = @import("../std.zig");
const builtin = @import("builtin");

pub const fd_t = i32;

pub const STDIN_FILENO = 0;
pub const STDOUT_FILENO = 1;
pub const STDERR_FILENO = 2;
pub const PATH_MAX = 1023;
pub const syscall_bits = switch (builtin.cpu.arch) {
    .x86_64 => @import("plan9/x86_64.zig"),
    else => @compileError("more plan9 syscall implementations (needs more inline asm in stage2"),
};
/// 移植自 /sys/include/ape/errno.h

    SUCCESS = 0,
    DOM = 1000,
    RANGE = 1001,
    PLAN9 = 1002,

    @"2BIG" = 1,
    ACCES = 2,
    AGAIN = 3,
    // WOULDBLOCK = 3, // TODO：errno.h 对 3 定义了 2 个名称。
    BADF = 4,
    BUSY = 5,

    EXIST = 8,

    INTR = 11,

    IO = 13,

    MFILE = 15,

    NAMETOOLONG = 17,
    NFILE = 18,
    NODEV = 19,
    NOENT = 20,
    NOEXEC = 21,
    NOLCK = 22,
    NOMEM = 23,
    NOSPC = 24,
    NOSYS = 25,
    NOTDIR = 26,
    NOTEMPTY = 27,
    NOTTY = 28,
    NXIO = 29,
    PERM = 30,
    PIPE = 31,
    ROFS = 32,
    SPIPE = 33,

    // bsd 网络软件
    NOTSOCK = 36,

    CONNREFUSED = 38,
    AFNOSUPPORT = 39,
    NOBUFS = 40,
    OPNOTSUPP = 41,
    ADDRINUSE = 42,

    MSGSIZE = 44,
    NOPROTOOPT = 45,
    SOCKTNOSUPPORT = 46,

    ADDRNOTAVAIL = 48,
    NETDOWN = 49,

    NETRESET = 51,
    CONNABORTED = 52,

    HOSTUNREACH = 59,

    DQUOT,

    OVERFLOW,
    LOOP,
    TXTBSY,
};

/// 从系统调用返回值中获取 errno。SUCCESS 表示无错误。
pub fn errno(r: usize) E {
    const signed_r: isize = @bitCast(r);
    const int = if (signed_r > -4096 and signed_r < 0) -signed_r else 0;
    return @fromBackingInt(@intCast(int));
}

// errstr 缓冲区可容纳的最大字节数
pub const ERRMAX = 128;
var errstr_buf: [ERRMAX]u8 = undefined;
/// 获取最近一次 errstr 的内容
pub fn errstr() []const u8 {
    _ = syscall_bits.syscall2(.ERRSTR, @intFromPtr(&errstr_buf), ERRMAX);
    return std.mem.span(@as([*:0]u8, @ptrCast(&errstr_buf)));
}
pub const Plink = anyopaque;
pub const Tos = extern struct {
    /// 逐进程性能分析
    prof: extern struct {
        /// 已知为 0(ptr)
        pp: *Plink,
        /// 已知为 4(ptr)
        next: *Plink,
        last: *Plink,
        first: *Plink,
        pid: u32,
        what: u32,
    },
    /// 若有周期时钟，则为其频率，否则为 0
    cyclefreq: u64,
    /// 内核中消耗的周期数
    kcycles: i64,
    /// 进程消耗的周期数（内核态 + 用户态）
    pcycles: i64,
    /// 顺便在此处放置 pid
    pid: u32,
    clock: u32,
    // 栈顶位于此处
};

pub var tos: *Tos = undefined; // 在 start.zig 中设置
pub fn getpid() u32 {
    return tos.pid;
}
pub const SIG = struct {
    /// 挂断
    pub const HUP = 1;
    /// 中断
    pub const INT = 2;
    /// 退出
    pub const QUIT = 3;
    /// 非法指令（捕获时不重置）
    pub const ILL = 4;
    /// 由 abort 使用
    pub const ABRT = 5;
    /// 浮点异常
    pub const FPE = 6;
    /// 终止（不可捕获或忽略）
    pub const KILL = 7;
    /// 段访问违规
    pub const SEGV = 8;
    /// 向没有读取方的管道写入
    pub const PIPE = 9;
    /// 闹钟
    pub const ALRM = 10;
    /// 由 kill 发出的软件终止信号
    pub const TERM = 11;
    /// 用户自定义信号 1
    pub const USR1 = 12;
    /// 用户定义的信号 2
    pub const USR2 = 13;
    /// 总线错误
    pub const BUS = 14;
    // 必须定义下列符号，但不必支持这些信号
    /// 子进程已终止或停止
    pub const CHLD = 15;
    /// 若已停止则继续
    pub const CONT = 16;
    /// 停止
    pub const STOP = 17;
    /// 交互式停止
    pub const TSTP = 18;
    /// 后台进程组成员读取控制终端
    pub const TTIN = 19;
    /// 后台组成员向控制终端写入
    pub const TTOU = 20;
};
pub const sigset_t = c_long;
pub const siginfo_t = c_long;
// TODO plan9 没有 sigaction_fn。Sigaction 不是联合体，但为兼容起见仍在此包含它。
pub const Sigaction = extern struct {
    pub const handler_fn = *const fn (i32) callconv(.c) void;
    pub const sigaction_fn = *const fn (i32, *const siginfo_t, ?*anyopaque) callconv(.c) void;

    handler: extern union {
        handler: ?handler_fn,
        sigaction: ?sigaction_fn,
    },
    mask: sigset_t,
    flags: c_int,
};
pub const AT = struct {
    pub const FDCWD = -100; // 这里只是人为定义一个常量；Plan 9 实际上不存在 FDCWD 和 openat
};
// Plan 9 不支持信号。此内容仅用于使 start.zig 通过。
pub fn sigemptyset() sigset_t {
    return 0;
}
// TODO 实现 sigaction
// 目前只是允许使用 start.zig 代码的兼容实现
pub fn sigaction(sig: u6, noalias act: ?*const Sigaction, noalias oact: ?*Sigaction) usize {
    _ = oact;
    _ = act;
    _ = sig;
    return 0;
}

pub fn openat(dirfd: i32, path: [*:0]const u8, flags: u32, _: mode_t) usize {
    // 跳过 perms，因为仅 create 支持 perms。
    if (dirfd == AT.FDCWD) { // openat(AT_FDCWD, ...) == open(...)
        return open(path, flags);
    }
    var dir_path_buf: [std.fs.max_path_bytes]u8 = undefined;
    var total_path_buf: [std.fs.max_path_bytes + 1]u8 = undefined;
    const rc = fd2path(dirfd, &dir_path_buf, std.fs.max_path_bytes);
    if (rc != 0) return rc;
    var fba = std.heap.FixedBufferAllocator.init(&total_path_buf);
    var alloc = fba.allocator();
    const dir_path = std.mem.span(@as([*:0]u8, @ptrCast(&dir_path_buf)));
    const total_path = std.fs.path.join(alloc, &.{ dir_path, std.mem.span(path) }) catch unreachable; // 此次分配不应失败，因为大小不应超过 max_path_bytes。
    fba.reset();
    const total_path_z = alloc.dupeSentinel(u8, total_path, 0) catch unreachable; // 不应超过 max_path_bytes + 1
    return open(total_path_z.ptr, flags);
}

pub fn fd2path(fd: i32, buf: [*]u8, nbuf: usize) usize {
    return syscall_bits.syscall3(.FD2PATH, @bitCast(@as(isize, fd)), @intFromPtr(buf), nbuf);
}

}

pub fn exit(status: u8) noreturn {
    if (status == 0) {
        exits(null);
    } else {
        // TODO：Plan 9 没有退出码。只能以 0 或字符串退出
        const arr: [1:0]u8 = .{status};
        exits(&arr);
    }
}

pub fn exits(status: ?[*:0]const u8) noreturn {
    _ = syscall_bits.syscall1(.EXITS, if (status) |s| @intFromPtr(s) else 0);
    unreachable;
}

/// Brk 将系统认定的、程序未使用的最低 bss 地址，
/// 即 break，设为 addr 向上舍入到
/// 8 字节整数倍后的地址。不小于 addr
/// 且低于栈指针的位置，访问时可能导致
/// 内存违规。——9front brk(2)
pub fn brk_(addr: usize) i32 {
    return @intCast(syscall_bits.syscall1(.BRK_, addr));
}
var bloc: usize = 0;
var bloc_max: usize = 0;

pub fn sbrk(n: usize) usize {
    if (bloc == 0) {
        // 我们位于起始位置
        bloc = @intFromPtr(&ExecData.end);
        bloc_max = @intFromPtr(&ExecData.end);
    }
    const bl = std.mem.alignForward(usize, bloc, std.heap.pageSize());
    const n_aligned = std.mem.alignForward(usize, n, std.heap.pageSize());
    if (bl + n_aligned > bloc_max) {
        // 需要分配
        if (brk_(bl + n_aligned) < 0) return 0;
        bloc_max = bl + n_aligned;
    }
    bloc = bloc + n_aligned;
    return bl;
}
